title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 75C for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under Chapter 79 of the G.L. for the right to take by eminent domain such rights-of-way, permanent easements, temporary easements or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and/or removal of natural gas transmission pipeline appliances, appurtenances and other equipment situated in the Towns of Upton and Hopkinton in the Counties of Worcester and Middlesex, respectively.
